problem.text: Chat parsed explicit top-K values as floats, then passed them through ComboSampler to SS_TopK, which used the value directly as a slice boundary.

reasoning.text: The change repairs both the chat input boundary and the shared sampling step: chat parses integers, while SS_TopK asserts integrality and converts accepted values to int.

impact.text: ComboSampler additionally selects greedy sampling when top_k equals 1, matching the existing TopKSampler shortcut.

source_notes.text: PR #35, “humaneval.py: fix top_k type, remove rep_p, add qwen3,” was opened by gakada and explicitly reports the float-index problem. Its relationship to this turboderp-authored change is inferred from the matching top_k indexing mechanism, not an explicit upstream link; its repetition-penalty report is separate.

PR #22, “OpenAI compatible API example,” concerns an API example and integration problems. Its discussion includes chat.py usage and a ComboSampler call; those overlaps do not establish that this commit addresses its reported problems.

limitations: No repository sampling or GPU tests were executed. The scalar check used Python 3.14.4; availability of int.is_integer on historical supported Python versions is unestablished by the inspected evidence.
The assertion-based integrality guard was checked with assertions enabled; optimized-Python behavior and end-to-end generation were not tested.

chapters.title: Normalize top-K counts and shortcut greedy sampling

claims.text: SS_TopK prepares sorted scores, then masks entries from index K onward with zero probabilities or negative-infinite logits. Its unchanged alternative replaces K < 1 with a no-op, so zero continues to mean disabled rather than an empty candidate set.

The constructor now checks top_k.is_integer() before storing int(top_k). This accepts integral floating-point counts without silently rounding fractional values when assertions are enabled. Centralizing conversion also covers callers other than the chat parser; the parent HumanEval parser still declares top_k as float and is not changed here.

For top_k == 1, ComboSampler retains repetition, presence and frequency penalty steps but bypasses temperature, min-P, top-K, top-P and categorical sampling. SS_Argmax selects the maximum input or penalty-adjusted logit and marks sampling complete. The penalty steps produce unsorted logits, so this new route does not require the callee's sorted-state branches.
The shortcut plausibly avoids unnecessary filtering and random sampling for a single retained candidate; no performance improvement or tie-behavior equivalence was measured.

A standard-library transcription on Python 3.14.4 accepted 0, 2, 0.0 and 2.0, rejected 2.5 with AssertionError, and reproduced TypeError for a list slice using 2.0. A minimal argparse check parsed the new integer option successfully. These checks exercise Python scalar behavior, not repository tensors or generation.

annotation.summary: Normalizes top-K counts at the chat parser and shared sampling step, and routes ComboSampler’s K=1 case directly to greedy selection.
